name: STPI – Next Generation Incubation Scheme (NGIS)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
brief: NGIS is a government scheme that helps nurture early-stage tech startups by providing incubation support, funding, and mentorship so they can develop strong, scalable business ideas.
briefFull: NGIS is a government scheme that helps nurture early-stage tech startups by providing incubation support, funding, and mentorship so they can develop strong, scalable business ideas.
details:
Next Generation Incubation Scheme (NGIS), under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, is a government scheme that helps nurture early-stage tech startups by providing incubation support, funding, and mentorship so they can develop strong, scalable business ideas.
**OBJECTIVES**
• It is a startup incubation scheme by Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) under MeitY, aimed at strengthening India’s software product startup ecosystem, especially in Tier-II/III cities. It aims to handhold 300 tech startups across 12 STPI incubation locations in Tier-II/III cities.
benefits:
• Seed / risk funding up to ₹25 lakh for promising startups.
• Access to state-of-the-art incubation infrastructure, labs, equipment, and testing facilities.
• Mentoring, startup-connect, industry networking, marketing support, and product lifecycle guidance.
• Internship / challenge grants for selected startups
eligibility:
• Indian startups working on software product development / technology-based solutions.
• DPIIT-recognised startups are encouraged; individuals, academicians, researchers, entrepreneurs, LLPs, and partnership firms may also participate but may need to register as a private limited company if selected.
howToApply:
[Online]
> Applicants can submit their proposals online through the STPI Startup Portal during open NGIS application calls.
documentsRequired:
- Certificate of Incorporation/Startup Registration
- DPIIT Recognition Certificate (if applicable)
- Detailed Business/Project Proposal
- Pitch Deck or Startup Profile
- Company/Founder Profile and Financial Details

faqs.q: What is the Next Generation Incubation Scheme (NGIS)?
faqs.a: NGIS is a MeitY scheme implemented through STPI to support early-stage technology startups with incubation, funding, mentorship, and other support.

faqs.q: What is the main objective of NGIS?
faqs.a: The scheme aims to strengthen India’s software product startup ecosystem, particularly in Tier-II and Tier-III cities.
Indian startups working on software product development or technology-based solutions can apply.

faqs.q: Can individuals or entrepreneurs participate in NGIS?
faqs.a: Yes. Individuals, academicians, researchers, entrepreneurs, LLPs, and partnership firms may participate, subject to the applicable NGIS guidelines and call requirements.

faqs.q: Is DPIIT recognition required for NGIS?
faqs.a: DPIIT-recognised startups are encouraged to apply, but eligibility may depend on the specific NGIS call.

faqs.q: What financial support is available under NGIS?
faqs.a: Selected promising startups may receive seed/risk funding of up to ₹25 lakh.
Startups can access incubation infrastructure, laboratories, equipment, testing facilities, and other resources.

faqs.q: Does NGIS provide mentorship to startups?
faqs.a: Yes. Startups receive mentorship and guidance for business and product development.
Yes. The scheme provides startup-connect and industry networking opportunities.
Yes. Startups can receive product lifecycle guidance and support for developing and improving their technology products.
